In Germany, GTA 6 costs about five hours of work. In Nigeria… about a month and a half.
GTA 6 costs 80 dollars. So how long would you work on minimum wage to buy it?
In Germany and the UK, about five hours. Less than one work day.
In the United States, on the federal minimum wage, eleven hours.
In Brazil, about eight full work days.
In Egypt, around sixteen work days. More than half a month.
And in Nigeria, about a month and a half of work… for one game.
Store prices change a little from country to country, but the gap is still huge.
How long would you need to work in your country? Tell me in the comments.
